title: Here’s Where to Watch ‘The Challenge: Cutthroat’ Online for Free
summary: Season 42 of the reality competition series airs starting Wednesday (Aug. 5).
contentText:

Set throughout locations across Thailand, host T.J. Lavin returns for The Challenge: Cutthroat . For season 42, watch contestants from The Real World , Love Island , Survivor , Big Brother , Too Hot to Handle and other reality series battle it out to become the ultimate challenger and win the grand prize.

Starting with a two-episode season premiere on Wednesday (Aug 5), you can stream The Challenge: Cutthroat on Paramount+ — instead of its longtime home on MTV .

How to Watch The Challenge: Cutthroat Online, At a Glance:

- Date: Starting on Wednesday, Aug. 5

- Start Time: 3 a.m. ET/12 a.m. PT

- Streaming Platform: DirecTV , Paramount+

Watch on DirecTV

When Does The Challenge: Cutthroat Start ?

The reality series The Challenge: Cutthroat streams on Paramount+, with a release time of 3 a.m. ET/12 a.m. PT on Wednesdays.

Where to Watch  The Challenge: Cutthroat Online for Free

For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch The Challenge: Cutthroat , especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial , which features free access to Paramount+.

STREAM ON 3 DEVICES AT ONCE

Paramount+

Get Paramount+

There are two plans to choose from: Paramount+ Essential and Paramount+ Premium (with Showtime).

Paramount+ has The Challenge: Cutthroat streaming online, as well as past seasons. If you don’t already have a Paramount+ subscription, the streaming service plan goes for $8.99 per month (or $89.99 per year). With Paramount+ , you’ll get access to a wide selection of TV shows and movies, live sports, 24-hour news with CBS News and more.

In addition, the streaming service includes a wide selection of music programming and specials, such as The New Edition Story , Love & Hip Hop Miami , Wu-Tang Clan: Of Mics and Men , MTV Unplugged , Willie Nelson & Family and others.
